settings.description: RocketBoyz is more than a snack brand — it is a love letter to Caribbean culture, wrapped in bold flavors and delivered straight to your door.

settings.title: The Craving That Started It All
settings.body: Wayne missed the snacks he grew up on in Jamaica. After searching everywhere and coming up empty, he decided to fix the problem himself.

settings.title: First Shipment Lands
settings.body: The first crate of authentic Jamaican snacks arrived stateside. Word spread fast through the Caribbean diaspora community.

settings.title: RocketBoyz Goes Online
settings.body: The brand launched its e-commerce platform, making Caribbean snacks accessible to anyone across the country with a few clicks.

settings.title: Wholesale & Beyond
settings.body: RocketBoyz expanded into wholesale, partnering with corner stores, Caribbean restaurants, and cultural shops nationwide.

settings.title: Still Growing, Still Authentic
settings.body: Today RocketBoyz carries hundreds of products from across the Caribbean — and we are just getting started.
